newsitem.title: SINGAPORE: Wing Tai top bidder in Singapore tender.
newsitem.headline: Wing Tai top bidder in Singapore tender.

text.p: Wing Tai Holdings Ltd has emerged as the top bidder for two prime sites in a hotly contested Singapore residential land tender, according to tender results released by the Urban Redevelopment Authority (URA) on Wednesday.
Through subsidiary Grandwin Investment Pte Ltd, it submitted Singapore $354.4 million or S$11,879 psm for a prime 14,206.6 sqm site at Draycott Drive beating nine other developers.
Through another subsidiary, Winfar Investment Pte Ltd, it also submitted the top bid of S$230 million for a 12,471.4 sqm site at Newton Road.
"I think prices are very high especially for the Draycott and Newton sites especially since they are 99-year leasehold sits," Lim Chung Chun, investment analyst at ING Baring Securities said.
He said apartments built at the Draycott site would probably have to be sold around S$2,000 per sq ft.

Two other residential sites at Dunman Road and Chun Tin Road secured top bids from property tycoon Ng Teng Fong's Far East Organisation which bid S$67.7 million and S$27.4 million for the respective sites.
